source.title: TNoodle 0.13.1
source.content:
TNoodle-WCA-0.13.1 is now available from https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles/
The following changes have been made since TNoodle 0.12.0:

 - TNoodle now supports connecting to the WCA website to retrieve the events and rounds of a competition.
 - FMC sheets are now available in 22 languages. The full list is available here: https://github.com/thewca/tnoodle/tree/v0.13.1/webscrambles/src/i18n.
	
Please remember that official competitions must use the current version of the official scramble program. This is always available from:
https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles/

translation.title: TNoodle 0.13.1 发布
translation.content:
TNoodle-WCA-0.13.1 现已发布，可在 https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles/ 获取。

相较于 TNoodle 0.12.0，本次改动如下：

- TNoodle 现可连接 WCA 网站，获取比赛的项目和轮次信息。
- 最少步纸张现提供 22 种语言。完整列表见：https://github.com/thewca/tnoodle/tree/v0.13.1/webscrambles/src/i18n.

请注意，正式比赛必须使用当前版本的官方打乱程序。最新版始终可在 https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles/ 获取。
